name: zapret-discord-youtube
one_liner: A Windows tool that helps people in countries with internet blocking get Discord and YouTube working again, by tricking the network filters that are censoring them.
buyer: No legitimate commercial buyer — this is a free circumvention tool built for individual users facing government internet censorship (primarily in Russia), not a business opportunity.
business_use_cases: None that are ethically or commercially sound — its entire purpose is bypassing state network filtering, which sits outside normal business use cases.
A VPN or proxy company could study its bypass techniques to improve their own commercial censorship-resistant products, but reselling this tool itself is not viable.
Community tech-support channels (Telegram/Discord) around it could sustain themselves on donations, not product sales.

money_ideas.idea: None recommended — monetizing a censorship-circumvention tool directly is legally and ethically fraught in its target markets.

steal_this: Not a legitimate weekend business idea. Skip this one.
